'''Tyffix''' was a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Tyffix and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Cal (Jedi)|Cal]], were dispatched to lead a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]] when the world's populace attempted to secede from the Republic. Shortly after arriving on the planet, the Republic forces were [[Battle of Thustra|attacked]] by the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]], and Tyffix was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a suicide [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Ramming/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Thustra Republic command center|Republic command center]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Sephi have tanks here&hellip; and here.''"<br />"''Master Tyffix, have your men fall back from the outer&mdash;|A clone officer and Tyr, moments before the command center explodes|<ref name="JY" />}}
[[File:Cal_HS.jpg|thumb|left|While a Jedi Master, Tyffix took Cal (pictured) as their Padawan.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]], Tyffix was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who held the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="JY" /> Forced to wear a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] in order to survive in an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-rich [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="GtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Tyffix selected the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cal (Jedi)|Cal]] as their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] the youth to think like a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]].<ref name="JY" />

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Tyffix and Cal were part of a Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|task force]] sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]] when the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sephi/Legends|Sephi]] population wanted to secede from the Republic. What was originally planned to be a show of force soon turned into a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] [[Battle of Thustra|battle]], in which Sephi [[Death/Legends|suicide]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] inflicted heavy casualties on the Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]. While discussing strategy with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Tyr]] and a [[Unidentified clone officer (Thustra)|clone officer]] inside the [[Thustra Republic command center|Republic command center]], Tyffix was victim to the [[Ramming/Legends|Sephi tactics]] when a suicide bomber destroyed the command tent, killing all present except Tyr's Padawan, [[Pix (Jedi)|Pix]], whom her Master had [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] out of the tent before the explosion. Cal saw the explosion from afar and called out for his master. Cal and Pix then sent a message to the Jedi and Republic on<ref name="JY" /> the planet<ref name="GtAS" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] informing them of Tyffix and Tyr's deaths and calling for help.<ref name="JY" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Master Tyffix!''"<br />"''Cal&hellip; It's too late.|Cal and Pix, after their Masters' deaths|<ref name="JY" />}}
Tyffix taught Cal that thinking like a warrior and a conqueror would be the only way to survive the Clone Wars, a lesson the Padawan took to [[Heart/Legends|heart]] but one that ultimately led to the Padawan's death later during the battle.<ref name="JY" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order, Tyffix was Force-sensitive and trained to [[Force power/Legends|wield]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at a high level.<ref name="JY" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi wore a breath mask and donned [[Color/Legends|brown]]-colored [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]].<ref name="JY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyffix appeared in ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'', the fifth and final issue of the [[Star Wars: Jedi (one-shots)|''Star Wars: Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[Jeremy Barlow]], illustrated by [[HOON]],<ref name="JY" /> and released on [[July 21]], [[2004]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54285/star_wars_jedi_-_yoda_2004_1|text=Star Wars: Jedi - Yoda (2004) #1}}</ref>
